A small closed oval 0 and separate short horizontal hyphen stand between schémas and connexes. X follows. The line under munis is confined to that word and is not a deletion.

notes: This page describes the effective homomorphism on chosen profinite fundamental groups, the interpretation of a 1-connected Y-scheme as a fibre-functor base object, and a functor from schemes with chosen universal covers to profinite groups. It ends at the dash after the phrase about geometrically pointed schemes; nothing is completed.

Logical line count 23: 20 main text/math baselines including separately wrapped profinis at upper right and the cancelled fragment between paragraphs, 1 supralinear insertion sous-, and 2 standalone number entries 53 and 106. Formula numbers (6) and (7) already belong to main display baselines.
The subscript in B is Pi(X), with X visibly written. The following phrase says étale covers of Y. The mismatch is retained as an authorial notation issue; X is not silently corrected to Y.
No genuine diagram or drawing occurs. Formula (6) has a plain right arrow. Formula (7) has a left bar and right arrowhead. The curve before cat. is the insertion leader for sous-.
The doubtful deleted que is present in C but has no supplied marks.tsv id. It is retained in place and in doubts; no artificial mark id is created.

A free tilde above the deleted superscript is visible. Cancellation masks whether the lower looped letter is X or alpha. New uncertainty retains C’s base reading; H’s unaccented alpha is not silently accepted.

Live on before devrait is not crossed out. H’s struck illegible entry there is not supported by an independent strike. H’s doubts on point, devrait, peut and dire were checked in full native-line context; their base words are retained.

Short forms remain as written: hom without a stop or second om, gén. with a stop, rev without a stop in the topos clause, and raised t in p^t followed by géom without a stop. The other rev. occurrences visibly have their abbreviation stop.
Lower-left 106 is thin foliation writing, separate from upper page 53. Its hand is not securely attributed.
No independent proof verification was undertaken. The remarks and formulas were transcribed and compared internally; this is not a proof certificate.
